description: plutus is an R package from the Joint Global Change Research Institute developers for estimating electricity investment and stranded assets from GCAM scenarios. It processes generation by technology and vintage together with technology cost assumptions to derive capacity additions and associated expenditures. The public repository provides code and a worked R interface, with outputs that can be used in separate visualization workflows. Spatial coverage follows the regions in the supplied GCAM scenario. The documented expenditures are totals over model periods, commonly five years, not annual values. The package is freely available under BSD-2-Clause and supports comparisons of infrastructure investment across energy-transition pathways. A limitation is that the README limits compatibility to GCAM version 6 or earlier and excludes GCAM-USA. It also notes that rooftop photovoltaic investment is not tracked. No directly related existing catalogue record was established for the general GCAM dependency. The package was not executed, and no scenario database or model outputs were downloaded.
inputs: GCAM electricity generation by technology and vintage
